name: No_risk_Betting
description: Betting app for people who don't want to risk real money: live Kalshi odds, a virtual $1,000 and a forecasting score.

paragraphs: All the thrill of a betting app with none of the money: bet a virtual $1,000 on real, live Kalshi odds — sports, politics, economics and more — and find out whether your predictions are actually right.
▶ Open the live app · works on phone and laptop (free server: the first visit can take up to a minute to wake up)
divergent prices; many "fake betting" apps use mock or no-vig odds. This reads Kalshi's production market data.
features: Real odds, fake money — live prices from Kalshi's production markets and a virtual $1,000 balance; nothing real is ever wagered
Honest fills — bets walk the live order book and pay Kalshi's fee, so results match what real money would have done
Parlays and a bet slip — tap + on any outcome to build multi-leg parlays with the combined payout shown
Forecasting Score — Brier score, log-loss and a calibration curve that measure whether you're right, not just lucky
Market pages — price-history charts, "how this market resolves" rules, live game scores and an optional predict-before-you-bet step
